# Micah 6 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 6:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "Hear, O-mountains, the-case-of YHWH, and-you-enduring-foundations-of the-earth! For YHWH has-a-case against-His-people, and-with-Israel He-will-argue. |
| LOGOS | "Hear, you mountains, the indictment of the LORD, and you enduring foundations of the earth, for the LORD has an indictment against His people, and He will contend with Israel. |
| PNEUMA | "And now, O mountains, listen to the LORD's complaint! He has a case against His people. He will bring charges against Israel. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:6 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "With-what shall-I-come-before YHWH, bow-myself before-God-on-high? Shall-I-come-before-Him with-burnt-offerings, with-calves sons-of-a-year? |
| LOGOS | "With what shall I come before the LORD, and bow myself before God on high? Shall I come before Him with burnt offerings, with calves a year old? |
| PNEUMA | "What can I bring to the LORD? Should I bow before God Most High with burnt offerings, with year-old calves? |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:12 (overlap: 4%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | For her-rich-men are-full-of violence, and-her-inhabitants speak lies, and-their-tongue [is] deceit in-their-mouth. |
| LOGOS | Your rich men are full of violence; your inhabitants speak lies, and their tongue is deceitful in their mouth. |
| PNEUMA | The rich among you have become wealthy through violence. The people are so used to lying that their tongues can no longer tell the truth. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:1 (overlap: 5%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Hear, please, what YHWH says: "Arise, contend before the-mountains, and-let-the-hills hear your-voice!" |
| LOGOS | Hear what the LORD says: "Arise, plead your case before the mountains, and let the hills hear your voice." |
| PNEUMA | Listen to what the LORD is saying: "Stand up and state your case against Me. Let the mountains and hills be the witnesses." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:11 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Can-I-be-pure with-scales-of wickedness and-with-a-bag-of deceitful weights? |
| LOGOS | Shall I acquit the man with wicked scales and with a bag of deceitful weights? |
| PNEUMA | How can I tolerate your dishonest merchants with their weighted scales and bags of rigged weights? |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

---

## 6:16 (overlap: 6%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-kept [are] the-statutes-of Omri and-all the-work-of the-house-of Ahab, and-you-walk in-their-counsels, so-that I-may-make-you a-desolation and-her-inhabitants a-hissing; and-the-reproach-of My-people you-will-bear." |
| LOGOS | For you have kept the statutes of Omri, and all the works of the house of Ahab; and you have walked in their counsels, that I may make you a desolation, and your inhabitants a hissing; so you shall bear the scorn of My people." |
| PNEUMA | You have followed the wicked examples of Kings Omri and Ahab. You have continued their evil practices. So I will make an example out of you, bringing you to complete ruin. You will be mocked by people everywhere." |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
